authentication.csrf: MP_CSRF cookie plus X-CSRF-Token for unsafe requests
authentication.sessionLifetime: absolute from user_session.created_at, including historical rows: administrators 12 hours; members and guests 90 days; Cookie and server share these durations
authentication.revocation: password change atomically revokes every session, including the caller, and closes associated WebSockets after commit; authenticate again with the new password
authentication.cleanup: expired sessions removed at startup and hourly; guest profiles and owned data retained
authentication.rateLimits: login and guest creation have independent per-IP budgets using AUTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS, AUTH_WINDOW_SECONDS and AUTH_BLOCK_DURATION; reserve attempts atomically; saturated tracking rejects new sources until an active record expires
authentication.proxyChain: trust forwarding headers only from trusted peers; strip trusted X-Forwarded-For hops from right to left and use the first untrusted address

management.omittedVisibility: preserve current visibility and password unless a new password is supplied
management.roomNames: trimmed, case-insensitive with SQLite lower(), unique among active rooms on create and rename

websocket.authentication: session and room access cookies are sent by the browser
websocket.sessionValidation: revalidate after registration and before each command; idle sockets close at their absolute session deadline

chat.interval: CHAT_MIN_INTERVAL applies per authenticated user and stream; all rooms share the one public stream
chat.length: CHAT_MAX_LENGTH counts Unicode code points after trimming
chat.retention: each room and the public stream separately retain the latest CHAT_HISTORY_LIMIT messages; insert and prune commit atomically; timestamp ties follow insertion order
chat.rejection: RATE_LIMITED emits no chat message and persists nothing; active limiter reservations survive room runtime recreation and are bounded at 10000, rejecting new keys while full

queueSynchronization.queueEpoch: runtime UUID on snapshots and patches; versions are positive and monotonic within that epoch
queueSynchronization.baseline: only a complete player.state initializes a new epoch; reject retired epochs and request resync for patches without a baseline

queueMutations.mutationId: required, nonblank, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes
queueMutations.scope: authenticated actor plus room runtime; successful results replay for 60 seconds, across connections in that runtime only
queueMutations.retry: same ID and arguments returns the original ack without a second mutation; changed arguments are rejected as MUTATION_CONFLICT
queueMutations.unknown: an uncertain persistence result reserves its ID until runtime destruction and requires resync
queueMutations.capacity: 2048 records; reject new IDs when full instead of clearing prior reservations

queueLimits.count: pending items only, including priority items, excluding now-playing; per-user count uses authenticated publicId
queueLimits.batchOverflow: reject the whole batch before persistence with QUEUE_CAPACITY; HTTP returns 409
queueLimits.history: QUEUE_HISTORY_SIZE controls only the in-memory previous-track window; persisted history is retained

websocket.playNext: priority tracks play before shuffle; batch top preserves visible relative order, latest top precedes earlier top, ordinary reorder changes visible order only; priority persists in queue JSON
